steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each project is placed by its rating and whether its next action has a measure.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Red rating with no action
findings.fix: Record the action and its owner

findings.title: Next-quarter action with no measure
findings.fix: Add a measure with its target

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] pf-beta.md:12  Red rating with no action.
       Fix: Record the action and its owner.
[medium] pf-delta.md:19  Project with no owner.
       Fix: Assign an owner.
[low] pf-zeta.md:26  Next-quarter action with no measure.
       Fix: Add a measure with its target.
Not checked: Projects outside the register.
pros: Checks a project with a red rating and no action, a project with no owner, and a next-quarter action with no measure.
cons: Not checked: Projects outside the register.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-pm-portfolio-review skill on the records for this review.
